newsitem.title: DENMARK: Pedersen trumps Superfos bid for Phoenix.
newsitem.headline: Pedersen trumps Superfos bid for Phoenix.

text.p: Danish construction and building company Marius Pedersen on Thursday trumped a bid for local road-builder Phoenix Contractors by chemicals group Superfos A/S.
Pedersen, a provincial building contractor, said in a statement it offered Superfos shareholders 710 crowns per A-share and 625 crowns per C-share.

His bid beat Superfos' earlier public offer of 700 Danish crowns per share for Phoenix A-shares, and 620 crowns for its C-share and an offer from Norway's Rieber and Son of 650 Danish crowns for the A-share and 585 for the C-share.
The Copenhagen Stock Exchange said it had placed both Superfos and Phoenix on its watch list.
Superfos is busy expanding at home and abroad.
At 1325 GMT the Superfos share was 15 crowns up at 785, while Phoenix was a hefty 30 crowns higher at 620 crowns, down from a morning high of 625.
The Marius Pedersen share stood 50 crowns up on Wednesday's close at 2,250 crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
